name: LibreOffice
description_en:
LibreOffice is a product in the Document management category. Its directory profile covers Offline Access, File Type Conversion, File Recovery, e-Signature, Document Indexing, Document Assembly, Document Archiving, Collaboration Tools.

Additional listed capabilities include Version Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: support shared work and communication between participants; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
